A.text: For essential radiographs in children, a thyroid collar is used when the thyroid is in the primary beam, and a lead apron is used for a parent holding the child.

B.text: A parent who holds the child should wear a lead apron.

C.text: The thyroid collar is indicated when the thyroid is in the primary beam, not when it is outside it.

D.text: Routine patient shielding is no longer considered necessary according to the evidence.
